solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Foaming at the mouth while nursing broken toe, perhaps?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: furious, in a towering rage
second, cryptic meaning: someone with a broken toe hops about, and the pain would drive anyone wild

explanation.surface: Someone frothing with fury after breaking a toe.
explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads the phrase literally: hopping because of the injured foot, and cross about it too.
explanation.definitionFit: Being visibly enraged is idiomatically described as frothing or foaming at the mouth.

clue.text: Composer stripped for Native American tribe

indicators.note: something stripped has its outer covering taken off, so both end letters go

parts.note: Chopin, the Polish composer

explanation.surface: A composer pared down to make a tribe's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hopi are a Pueblo people of northeastern Arizona.

clue.text: Legendary king with weapon beating sword, battle-axe

parts.note: the pen is mightier than the sword, so it is the weapon that beats it
both are slang for a fierce, domineering woman

explanation.surface: A mythical monarch armed with a weapon that outdoes a sword and an axe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Weapon beating sword' points to the proverb 'the pen is mightier than the sword'; 'battle-axe' is not a weapon here but a formidable woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Uther Pendragon is King Arthur's father in Arthurian legend, and the title was also given to Arthur.

clue.text: Meeting client, senorita excited

definitions.note: used adjectivally, as in a meeting point

indicators.note: excited things are stirred up and agitated, so the letters before it are thrown into a new order

parts.note: the fourteen letters of both words

explanation.surface: A client gets to meet an excitable young Spanish woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Intersectional describes lines or roads that cross, the place where they come together or join.

clue.text: Potential killer, European breaking measure of work up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read from the bottom to the top
breaking into something means getting inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: the erg is a unit of work in physics
a Dane is a European from Denmark

explanation.surface: A European disrupting a work schedule could prove deadly.
explanation.definitionFit: A grenade is an explosive device that may kill, but only once thrown and detonated, hence potential.

clue.text: A heartless old F1 driver, father of many

indicators.note: without a heart means the central letter of the word is lost

parts.note: taken as written
Jack Brabham, Australian Formula One world champion of the 1950s and 60s

explanation.surface: A cruel former racing driver who sired a large brood.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the patriarch is promised he will be father of a multitude of nations; his name is glossed that way.

clue.text: Fish that's fat dropping by

indicators.note: dropping a word means leaving it out, so the next word is taken away

parts.note: plump, overweight
taken as written

explanation.surface: A plump fish that is slimming down.
explanation.definitionFit: The chub is a freshwater fish of the carp family, common in European rivers.

clue.text: Pledge to collect one, finding lift quickly

indicators.note: collecting something means gathering it in, so the following item ends up inside

parts.note: to hock is to pawn, leaving something as a pledge
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Pawning a single item to raise money in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: To hoick, a British informal verb, is to pull or yank something up with a sudden jerk.

clue.text: Generous offer shipping the gear abroad

indicators.note: abroad can mean widely scattered, so the letters are spread out and rearranged
a vessel shipping cargo carries it within, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a bid is an offer at auction
the seven letters of these words, rearranged

explanation.surface: A kind proposal to send equipment overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: A kind-hearted, open-handed person is said to have a big heart, which is to be charitable.

clue.text: It's hard to imagine those people getting singled out on tour of Slough

indicators.note: out can mean disordered or wrong, so the preceding letters need sorting into a new arrangement

parts.note: the pronoun for those people

indicators.note: going on a tour of a place travels all round it, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: the seven letters of this word, rearranged
a slough is a swamp or marsh

explanation.surface: Picture people being picked out on a tour of the Berkshire town of Slough: hardly believable.
explanation.walkthrough: Slough, capitalised as the Berkshire town near London, is the ordinary word for a marsh.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom said when something is too astonishing or vast to grasp or conceive.

clue.text: Drink containing old grape

indicators.note: containing means holding within, so the next piece goes inside

parts.note: a pint, as of beer
O is a standard abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: A glass of something made from a vintage grape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drink' looks like the definition, being next to 'grape'; it is the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinot is a family of wine grape varieties, such as Pinot Noir and Pinot Grigio.

clue.text: Human organ left in cup of tea?

parts.note: the ear is an organ of hearing

indicators.note: in places the preceding letter inside the next word

parts.note: as in 'not my cup of tea' or 'not my thing', a liking
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A body part is found floating in someone's teacup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cup of tea' means a personal preference, not a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: In science fiction, an earthling is a person from Earth, a human seen from an alien's viewpoint.

clue.text: I ask more quizzically about bouillon that's overwhelmed a fish dish

indicators.note: to overwhelm is to engulf, so the next letter is swallowed inside
about means around, so the jumbled letters go round the soup
quizzically suggests a puzzled, questioning twist, so the words are jumbled

parts.note: the eight letters of these words, to be rearranged
bouillon is a clear broth or stock
taken as written

explanation.surface: A diner keeps asking, puzzled, about the soup swamping their fish course.
explanation.walkthrough: An Arbroath smokie is a haddock smoked whole, a speciality of the Scottish fishing town Arbroath.
explanation.definitionFit: This smoked haddock, from a town on the Angus coast, is a classic Scottish seafood preparation.

clue.text: Animal with endless German ordnance: agree to confiscate that

indicators.note: confiscating means seizing and holding, so the next piece is taken inside

parts.note: to chime with is to agree or harmonise

indicators.note: endless means losing the final letter

parts.note: Panzer is the German word for tank, a heavy armoured weapon

explanation.surface: An instruction about seizing a beast and German weaponry.
explanation.definitionFit: The chimpanzee is a great ape of African forests, the closest living relative of humans.

clue.text: Cleanliness elevated boy or girl, reportedly?

indicators.note: reportedly signals that what is said, not what is written, counts here

parts.note: high means raised up
Jean is a man's name in French and a woman's name in English

explanation.surface: A question about whether a child's lofty position counts as being clean.
explanation.definitionFit: Hygiene is the practice of keeping clean to protect health, so cleanliness is a near synonym.

clue.text: I stop after short time — somewhere to get a little drink?

definitions.text: somewhere to get a little drink?

indicators.note: after says the piece before it is placed second, following the short time rather than leading

parts.note: min is short for minute
taken as written
to bar is to block or stop

explanation.surface: Someone pauses briefly to find a spot for a quick tipple.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful definition: a small bar is literally a mini bar, and its bottles are miniatures.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotel room's small fridge stocked with tiny bottles of spirits and soft drinks for guests.

clue.text: Ocean after the tracks initially in mind — on this?

definitions.text: Ocean after the tracks initially in mind — on this?

indicators.note: in places the picked letters inside the next word

parts.note: the brain is the seat of the mind

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the words before it

parts.note: the first letters of the four words

explanation.surface: A traveller on the rails is already thinking of the sea crossing to come.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: on this kind of rail journey, the sea beyond the line is the next leg.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat train runs to a port to connect with a ferry or liner, so its passengers continue by sea.

clue.text: Titanic battle, shower wiped from terrain

parts.note: the Battle of Mons, 1914, in Belgium

indicators.note: wiped from means removed out of, so one word is taken away from the other

parts.note: taken as written
a shower of rain

explanation.surface: Fighting on the land is so fierce that the weather is forgotten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Titanic' with a capital invites the ship; here it is simply the adjective meaning huge.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, monster means enormous or gigantic, and titanic likewise means of colossal size.

clue.text: Wife invested in African currency, an African

indicators.note: money invested in something is put inside it

parts.note: the rand is South Africa's currency
W is the abbreviation for wife
taken as written

explanation.surface: A wife has put money into a currency on the African continent.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rwandan is a native or citizen of Rwanda, a country in central-east Africa.

clue.text: Bread cut after vehicle leaves

indicators.note: something cut is shortened, so its last letter is lopped off

parts.note: a cab, or taxi
a bagel is a ring-shaped bread roll

explanation.surface: Someone slices bread after the taxi drives off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb about the vehicle departing, but it is the definition, a noun: a vegetable's leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Cabbage is a leafy vegetable, eaten as its tightly packed green or red leaves.

clue.text: Horror story German playwright hasn't begun

indicators.note: not having begun means the opening letter is missing

parts.note: Friedrich Schiller, German dramatist and poet

explanation.surface: A German dramatist's frightening tale is still unwritten.
explanation.definitionFit: A chiller is a frightening film or book, one intended to make the blood run cold.

clue.text: Under the circumstances, the Best Picture

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the best possible, given the situation
second meaning: the 1997 film starring Jack Nicholson and Helen Hunt

explanation.surface: It looks like an awards announcement for Best Picture.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface splits after 'the Best' rather than before it; the film was nominated for, but did not win, Best Picture.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means something is at its peak and cannot improve, and it is also the title of a Hollywood movie.

clue.text: Will written finally with name in Indian state

indicators.note: in places the preceding letters inside the next word

parts.note: Goa is a state on India's west coast

indicators.note: finally asks for the last letter of the word before it

parts.note: the final letter of this word
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: A testament is drawn up with someone's name in an Indian state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' looks like a legal document, given 'written'; it is the auxiliary verb.
explanation.definitionFit: In casual speech 'I'm gonna' is a contraction of going to, expressing future intention, as will does.

clue.text: In church, vice out of bounds

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for church

indicators.note: without its bounds, the word loses its edges and only the inside letters remain

parts.note: the inner letters of this word

explanation.surface: Sin within a church is forbidden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' looks like a linking preposition but is the definition: fashionable, as in 'the in thing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic means stylish and fashionable, and 'in' is informal for currently in fashion.

clue.text: Wine in cooler shown to the left alongside last of Shiraz

indicators.note: last of asks for the final letter of the following word

parts.note: the final letter of this word
taken as written
a fan cools the air

indicators.note: going to the left in an across clue means reading right to left

parts.note: led as in shown the way

explanation.surface: A bottle in the wine cooler sits beside a Shiraz.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cooler' and 'Shiraz' paint a wine scene, but the cooler is a fan and Shiraz just supplies its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Zinfandel is a red grape variety grown chiefly in California, and the wine made from it.

clue.text: Sound of sucker in drain

indicators.note: sound of points to a word that is pronounced the same as another

parts.note: a leech is a bloodsucking worm

explanation.surface: A noise from something slurping in a drain.
explanation.definitionFit: To leach is to drain away, as soluble chemicals percolate out of soil.

clue.text: Back in bureau, a seriously hairy man

indicators.note: back means the letters are read from right to left
in says the answer sits within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters spanning the end of the first word and the start of the last

explanation.surface: Behind a desk sits a very hirsute fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seriously' gives two letters to the wordplay and also reads as an intensifier for the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Esau, twin of Jacob, is described as a hairy man, his brother as smooth.

clue.text: Filth originally inside an incisor unfortunately too deep to pick up?

indicators.note: inside places that letter within the jumbled ones
unfortunately suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters are muddled

parts.note: the nine letters of these words, to be rearranged

indicators.note: originally asks for the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: the first letter of this word

explanation.surface: Dirt lodged in a tooth is buried too deep to remove.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pick up' suggests a toothpick, but means hear: 'deep' here is low in pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Infrasonic sound has a frequency below the range of human hearing, so the ear cannot detect it.
